About the Creator — KISS PRINCIPLE

I'm a solo Machine Learning researcher competing as KISS PRINCIPLE (Keep It Simple, Stupid). I believe powerful technology shouldn't require complicated tools or specialized backgrounds. With HELIOS, I'm making advanced analysis of preprocessed NASA NISAR-related radar data more accessible through an intuitive platform for statistical analysis, machine learning, diagnostics, and validation. My mission is simple: make sophisticated science easier to understand.
